dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A LOOP repeats the line below it. 'for i in range(3)' runs that line three times.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Place the repeated line one tile RIGHT. That indent is what puts it inside the loop.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A FUNCTION is a named block. 'def greet' names it; the indented lines below are its body.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Defining it doesn't run it. Write its name on its own line below, back at the left wall.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A function can take an ARGUMENT — a value you hand it. 'def greet(name)' declares a slot called name.

dialogue.speaker: narrator

goalSpec.description: Make the panel say: hello world

puzzles.prompt: Learn the ropes: pick up words, place them, then Build and Run.

payload.goal: Warm up the panel. Make your program say: hello world

beats.wrong-order: The words tumble out jumbled. Try them in a different order: the command first, then the words.
